definition: An automation workflow in Workato: a trigger plus one or more actions. Recipes belong to projects and folders and run as jobs.
A single execution of a recipe. Jobs have handles (IDs), a status (succeeded/failed/pending), and per-step data in the job trace.
A value from a previous recipe step, referenced in later steps. Rendering caveat: DSL exports can show a mapped datapill as its resolved sample value.
A reusable flow inside a recipe (same workspace), callable by other recipes; must be RUNNING to invoke. Trigger type workato_recipe_function.
A recipe callable cross-project/cross-workspace over HTTP; being replaced by API recipes per Workato docs.
A recipe exposed as an API endpoint via the API Platform (New API request trigger + Response action). Replaces callable-recipe endpoints.
An export-manifest: a named, versioned selection of workspace assets for environment promotion. URL pattern app.workato.com/export_manifests/<id>.
A zipped deployment bundle produced from a manifest; imported into a target workspace (optionally restarting recipes).
Structured relational-ish storage inside Workato (columns with types, field_ids); REST surface data-tables.workato.com. Distinct from lookup tables.
Simple key-value reference storage, row CRUD via Developer API.
The top-level organizational container in a workspace; projects hold folders and assets, and project-scoped properties.
Verified User Access: a skill/MCP tool runs as the calling end user's connection instead of a service identity. Set via connection personalization; can silently revert after recipe pushes.
Workspace-admin-created credential for the Developer API: role + project scopes; generates the bearer token.
The OPA: network agent connecting on-prem systems to Workato.
Workato's Kafka-based streaming layer (topics, schemas), distinct from recipe polling/webhooks.
Workato's recipe performance scan (POST /api/recipes/:id/health queues one).
Workato's scheduled data-sync feature (SQL-workspace-like transformations between connectors).
Workato's conversational-bot framework for Slack/Teams surface integration.
